intro: The Blasted Lands are a desolate expanse of red clay and barren rock at the southeastern tip of the Eastern Kingdoms, ruined by the chaotic energies of the Dark Portal. Once part of the verdant Black Morass, the shattered earth now harbors demonic remnants of the Burning Legion, brutal Dreadmaul ogres, and hardy desert beasts. Nethergarde Keep stands vigil over the desolate wasteland, guarding Azeroth from whatever horrors may spill out of the dormant gateway.

p: Before the First War, this region was a continuation of the dense fenlands known as the Black Morass. That lush swamp was utterly eradicated when the warlock Gul'dan and the possessed Medivh tore open the Dark Portal to unleash the orcish Horde. Chaotic fel energies bled through the dimensional breach, stripping all moisture and baking the earth into cracked red clay. When the Dark Portal was later destroyed at the end of the Second War, catastrophic shockwaves scorched the terrain further, transmuting the native stone into its unearthly crimson hue.

Perched upon the northern bluffs, Nethergarde Keep watches over the only road entering the valley. Commissioned by Archmage Khadgar and the Kirin Tor following the Second War, this stone bastion is manned by grim mages and stalwart soldiers sworn to prevent any renewed demonic or orcish incursions. It is an uninviting and strictly disciplined posting; infractions among the garrison are punished with banishment to the Stockade in Stormwind. The defenders face relentless pressure from the Dreadmaul ogres who stayed behind after Draenor's fall, raiding the roads and attacking the fortress gates under fell guidance.

In the southwestern reaches lies the Tainted Scar, a cratered canyon teeming with the deadliest demonic force on the continent. Stranded after the defeat at Mount Hyjal, the doomguard commander Lord Kazzak gathers wandering demons, doomguard, and felhounds to his banner. High above the red barrens, his dreadlord lieutenant, Razelikh the Defiler, orchestrates mortal servitude among the Shadowsworn cultists at the Altar of Storms and commands the local Dreadmaul ogres.

Despite the land's desolation, scholars and wanderers brave its horrors for unique discoveries. Just inside the northern pass, Bloodmage Drazial and Bloodmage Lynnore conduct eccentric alchemical experiments, extracting organs from local scorpids, basilisks, and boars to brew extraordinarily potent physical enhancers. Farther into the wastes, a lone draenei hermit named Kum'isha seeks scattered draenethyst fragments, rewarding travelers who recover these alien remnants left behind by Draenor's shattered past.
